definition: a person who murders an important or famous person, usually for political or religious reasons
hook: Assassin used to just mean someone high on hashish.
modernAnchor: We use it for anyone who kills a president or a king, no drugs required.
journey: A Nizari Ismaili sect fought crusaders and rival rulers through targeted killings instead of open battles.
Their enemies called them hashishin, hashish users, claiming the killers were drugged before every mission.
Crusaders carried the story home and garbled the word into assassin as they retold it.
The drug claim was likely enemy propaganda, but the word outlived it and kept only the killing.
